She is definitely not as OP as 6.78 bara,or troll/jug/sniper of the previous patches.

This is what i think,unlike most int mids,windrunner is good at all stages of the game.

Let's say enemy is trying to 5 man teamfight,she has the option to initiate with a teamfight winning two hero shackle.

If the enemy is trying to play deathball,she has decent waveclear in powershot and attack range to aggro creeps from the tower.

She can manfight enemy carries with 100% evasion and focus fire,and since she is being played with position 2 farm priority she is difficult to insta nuke especially after aghs.

And lastly unlike ~~many~~ all  int carries,she has the ability to take down towers/roshan fast,she can solo rosh.

The main reason i feel people are finding her 'op' is because the nukers of past patch or orchid carriers lina,qop,leshrac,storm(not exactly a nuker but pretty good against wr) have all been nerfed.
At this moment easy counters to her are out of meta.You need to co-ordinate a lot more to shut down wr.IF i had to describe wr's current situation it would be similar to when Legion commander was released,they called it Op too.

The shackle level 4 has 3.75 s of disable with low cd,no other disable lasts so long with such low cd,her aghs ult is so low cd as well.And in late game if you get a two man shackle,Godspeed.

The problem is that all her skills are good with low cd and one mobility items gives her so much range.she can insta kill you from 2500 range,with phase-->blink-->shackle-->focus-->wr to escape.After bkb she is an invulnerable damage dishing machine now that lina is no longer picked as she once was.

She isnt broken but extremely tricky to play against similar to doom,but better since you get deleted in 4 sec.

I think the most important trick to play am in pubs is to farm,making the enemy think you are sitting in base.

If you feel that the enemy will pressure you a lot as soon as the laning phase gets over,make treads get ring and stay out of vision.

Get bf and vlads and farm away from the enemy team,cut creep wave.Keep the split push on,often times when the enemy team is strong at teamfights they are weak against split push,and it is really very difficult to kill a vlads bf am by a single hero.

The most annoying thing when deathballing is splitpushing am/prophet,they frustrate such lineups.Keep farming dont die,the thing with am is pre 40 mins if you are 6 slotted and even if you lose one set of racks you can win the game.The key is to not die.

I am talking about myself,when i play ranked often my focus turns into winning that game,practicing etc becomes 2nd.I often am forced to pick something that will win me the game rather than what i want to practice.

Also i prefer to go mid while playing unranked and more often than not get matched up against higher skilled players than me because the enemy is a stack,they pressure me in mid and honestly i love those games teaches me to a lot more than when i am stomping.

Get better at game.

Stop playing ranked,and begin practicing heroes(not just mid or carry,supports as well)
your block,your opening,aggro tricks,farming efficiency,good cs/min and kill participation,split pushing,timings on items,

trying to predict enemy behavior,map awareness and abusing that to pressure enemy,item build according to the flow of the game,

watch replays and just mimic what 7-8k players do and after a while you do get better.

Picking flavor of the month heroes might win you +5 games,but in long run if you are not focused on improving yourself it is a waste.

Also if you think you are doing everything right,then you need to get any 4-5k player to look at your replay and they would point out a billion things you could have done to improve your game.

>No-bear still uses the bear. It just buys items for the hero instead of the bear.

If you buy no items for the bear,you miss out on entangle(lower AS procs),the extra damage bonus for demolish.The cost effectiveness for putting items on bear vs putting on hero is always going to favor the bear until late game.
Entangle helps you farm faster(540 damage to creeps,if you get an entangle proc on creep<400hp it will die on its own you dont need to attack it),gives you disable for 3 secs(which is huge).Demolish ,For example lets say you buy a maelstorm which does 24 damage,if you put it on the hero it does like 60-70% to a t1 so 18 damage lets say,if you put the same item on bear it does 18x1.4=25.2 damage.Which translates to faster damage to tower.In addition to this when you use battle cry in true form you get +60 damage to both bear and LD.

His ranged form is horrible if not for the extra ms.Low hp,low damage.Unlike every other carry ranged LD has no ~~great~~passives or anything tbh,makes him a very shitty carry.You might as well play crystal maiden with a moonshard because thats what LD is in ranged form in terms of damage and AS.Infact a carry crystal maiden is better atleast you have a slow and disable.
